references.text: The same pattern of fifty loops is used for the goat-hair tent curtains, showing the tabernacle's unified construction.
The fulfillment of the instruction regarding the fifty gold hooks when the tabernacle was actually built.
A parallel text describing the bronze hooks that bind the tent curtain together into one unit.
The basic command to build the tabernacle according to God's pattern, detailed in chapter 26.
The Gershonites' responsibility for carrying the tabernacle's coverings and curtains, including those fastened with hooks.
The unity of the Spirit that binds believers together mirrors how the hooks bound the tabernacle into one.
The church as God's temple, joined together into a holy dwelling, parallel to the tabernacle's unity.
The execution of joining the boards confirms the same theological principle of unity that the gold hooks provide for the coverings.
